text:
```yaml
name: Detect potential duplicates

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]

jobs:
  detect-duplicates:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Detect potential duplicates
        uses: wow-actions/potential-duplicates@v1
        with:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          threshold: 90
          label: potential-duplicate
          comment: |
            Potential duplicate detected. Similar issues:
            {{similar_issues}}
```

name: Detect potential duplicates
